instruction: Research each restaurant from my list online and populate the spreadsheet with their website URLs along with other contact information.

metadata.explanation: Task requires filling restaurant information from restaurants.txt into MUST_VISIT.xlsx. This variation focuses on verifying that website URLs are properly filled in column D (Website column). The evaluator extracts all values from column 4 and checks that at least 3 entries contain valid-looking URLs (matching pattern for http://, https://, or www.). Partial credit is given proportionally to the number of URLs found.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct for verifying URL population in column 4
Getter correctly extracts non-empty values from the Website column (column 4, rows 2-20)
Metric correctly validates URLs using appropriate regex pattern (https?://|www\.)
Partial credit logic is sound (proportional scoring: url_count / min_count)
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before verification
INCOMPLETE COVERAGE: Instruction mentions 'along with other contact information' but evaluator only checks URLs, not other contact fields
Minimum count of 3 URLs is reasonable but not verified against actual restaurant count in restaurants.txt
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying other contact information columns (phone, address, etc.) for complete coverage of the instruction
Verify that min_count=3 matches the actual number of restaurants in restaurants.txt to ensure appropriate threshold
Consider checking if the URL values are semantically valid (not just pattern matching) for higher quality verification
